name: environment-probe
title_zh: 新环境先摸家底再动手的探针
tagline_zh: 进陌生沙箱或云开发机，一分钟内确认它已知什么、缺什么，写进笔记再开工。运行命令或端口一断，再探一次。
tagline_en: In under a minute, confirm what a new dev box already has, write findings to notes, then start coding. Re-run if.
desc_en: Probe a fresh sandbox or cloud dev box in under a minute, confirm what is already known about it, write the findings to a notes file, and report before any code is written. Use at the very start of a session, and again if a run command or port stops working.
why_zh: 不靠猜，靠探测。把环境状态固化成文件，让每次会话都从事实出发，而不是从「我记得上次能跑」出发。
why_en: Facts over memory. Turns environment state into a durable file, so every session starts from what is, not what you assume still.
limit_zh: 只探测本机可执行命令能触达的范围，不覆盖网络拓扑或外部服务；产物是 notes 文件，不自动修环境。
limit_en: Only probes what local commands can reach; no network topology or external services. Output is a notes file, not an auto-fixer.
title_en: Probe a fresh sandbox before writing code
